name: Feedback Clock
description: Aimed at people who put in hours of practice but improve slowly because mistakes go unnoticed for too long, it shortens that gap with direct, unsoftened assessment of the work. The bluntness is the point, so it suits learners who would rather be corrected than encouraged.

official.title: Feedback Clock by Sultanov
official.description: A blunt feedback engineer for people who practice a lot but learn slowly because the wait between doing the work and finding out it is wrong is too...
